Option A — Upload the file to Gmail (recommended)
1. Open Gmail in your browser.
2. Click Compose.
3. Drag the report file into the compose window (or click the paperclip attach icon and choose the file).
4. After the file finishes uploading, reply here and I will send the email from your account with that attachment.

Option B — Upload the file to Google Drive and share a link
1. Upload the file to your Google Drive.
2. Right-click the file → Get link → set sharing to “Anyone with the link” or share with partner@partners.example.
3. Send me the Drive link here and I’ll send the email with the link included (or attach if you share directly with me in Drive).

Option C — If you prefer, paste the file to a cloud storage link (Dropbox/OneDrive) and share the link here; I’ll include it in the message.

Final Q4 Customer Report

When you’ve attached the file and saved the draft, reply here (just say “Attached” or “Ready”) and I’ll locate the draft and send the email to partner@partners.example. If you want any edits to the cover note, CC, or BCC before I send, tell me now.

If you want, I can walk through checking that the draft was saved (what you should see in Drafts). Which would you prefer?
I'll upload the file to Google Drive and share the link here. Please hold on.

Okay — I’ll wait for the Drive link. When you paste it, I will:

- Include this cover note: "Hello, Please find attached the final Q4 customer report. Could you please confirm receipt? Thank you, [Your Name]" (I will replace [Your Name] with your account name unless you tell me otherwise)
- Attach or link the Drive file (I can attach if you share the file with me or include the link if it’s viewable)
- Send the message immediately
